# eXo Platform Documentation

> eXo Platform is an open-source digital workplace software that helps people work together, spanning communication, collaboration, knowledge management, and productivity. This site hosts the official developer, administrator, and user documentation for eXo Platform.

This documentation is intended primarily for developers building extensions and integrations on eXo Platform, as well as administrators and end users of the platform.

## Getting Started
- [Introduction](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/getting-started/Introduction.html): Overview of eXo Platform, its editions, and what the documentation covers
- [Start eXo community](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/getting-started/start-community.html): System requirements, prerequisites, and instructions to start the eXo Platform community edition (Docker-based setup)

## User and Administrator Guides
- [User and Administrator guides](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/): Documentation for using and administrating eXo Platform, packaged within the platform itself

## Developer Guide
- [Developer guide overview](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/developer-guide/): High-level tour of eXo Platform architecture and capabilities for developers
- [Getting started](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/developer-guide/getting-started.html): Setting up Maven, GIT, and the eXo Platform Maven repository for extension development
- Prepare extension project: First steps to set up an eXo Platform extension project
- [Simple Integration](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/developer-guide/): Basic customization capabilities (look and feel, templates, pages, navigation, content)
- [Intermediate Integration](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/developer-guide/intermediate-integration/): Building and integrating applications, including portlets and gadgets
  - [Develop a front end application](https://docs.exoplatform.org/guide/developer-guide/intermediate-integration/front-end-application): Building portlets with JSP, JSF, Spring MVC, or JS frameworks (Angular, React, VueJS); project structure, REST services, deployment
- REST API: Reference for eXo Platform's REST APIs
- Miscellaneous: Additional developer topics
- Product reference: Reference documentation for eXo Platform components
- Internationalization configuration: Configuring i18n support
- Developing JavaScript: Guidance for JavaScript development within eXo Platform

## Optional
- [eXo Platform website](https://www.exoplatform.com/): Official eXo Platform product website
- [eXo Platform blog](https://www.exoplatform.com/blog/): News, updates, and articles about eXo Platform
- [eXo Platform GitHub organization](https://github.com/exoplatform/): Source code repositories for eXo Platform and its modules
- [eXo Platform Maven repository](https://repository.exoplatform.org/): Maven repository for eXo Platform artifacts
- [eXo Community](https://community.exoplatform.com/portal/intranet/): eXo Tribe community labs platform to test and demo the latest lab version of eXo Platform
- [Try eXo](https://trial.exoplatform.org/portal/login): Start a free hosted trial of eXo Platform
- [eXo Hubs registration](https://hubs.exoplatform.org/portal/register): Register for eXo Hubs
